5. After filing written statement the defendant No. 1 on 06.01.2009 filed an application under order 7 Rule 11 of the Code for rejection of plaint stating, inter-alia, that the defendant No.1 got the land by inheritance from his late father Digendra. Chandra Sarker, who was the owner of the land by purchase, while Digendra Chandra Sarker was owing and possessing the land the Government claimed the land as vested property and as such Digendra Chandra Sarker filed Title Suit No. 292 of 1979 and obtained an ex-parte decree on 28.01.1981 and thereafter, the then Sub Divisional officer, Sadar North, Mymensingh filed other class suit No. 571 of 1981 in the Court of Munsif, 2nd Court, Mymensingh for setting-aside the said ex-parte decree. The said suit was subsequently, transferred to the Court of the then Munsif, Iswargonj for disposal, who however, dismissed the suit on 19.01.1986. The Additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue) Mymensingh on behalf of the Government filed. Miscellaneous case No. 100 of 1982 which was rejected on 15.05.1983. One Abdul Hye Ansar Commander took the land lease from the vested property authority under. the Government and filed other class suit No. 98 of 1981 for setting-aside the ex-parte decree passed in the said other class suit No. 292 of 1979. The said other class suit No. 98 of 1981 was dismissed on 31.08.1982 and the plaintiff filed Other Class Appeal in the Court of District Judge, Mymensingh which was dismissed on 18:4.86. The predecessor of the defendant No. 1 filed an application to the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue), Mymenshingh for releasing the property from the list of vested property and ultimately, the property has been released from the list of vested property and thereafter, the suit property was mutated in the name of the father of defendant No. 1, vide latter No. 3418(4) S. A. T. and Khatian No. 1034 has been opened in the name of the father of the defendant No. 1 and as such, the suit is barred by law of resjudicata. 

 15. It appears that the opposite party No. 1 as plaintiff instituted Other Class Suit No. 53 of 2007 in the Court of learned Senior Assistant Judge, Iswargonj for setting-aside the ex-pane decree dated 28.01.1981 on the allegation that the said ex-parte decree was obtained on practicing fraud upon the Court. After filing written statement the petitioner as defendant No. 1 on 06.012009 filed an application under order 7 Rule 11 of the Code for rejection of plaint stating, inter-alia, that the defendant No. 1 got the land by inheritance from his late father Digendra Chandra Sarker who was the owner of the land by purchase, while Digendra Chandra Sarker as owner was in possession of the land the Government claimed the land as vested property as such Digendra Chandra Sarker filed Title Suit No. 292 of 1979 and got a ex-partee decree on 28,01.1981. Thereafter, the then Sub-divisional officer, sadar (North) Mymensingh for setting aside the decree filed other class suit No. 571 of 1981 in the Court of Munsif, 2nd Court, Mymensingh, subsequently the said suit was transferred to the Court of Munsif Iswargonj, who dismissed the same on 19.01.1986. The Additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue), Mymensingh on behalf of the Government filed Miscellaneous case No. 100 of 1982 which was rejected on 15.05.1983. One Abdul Hye Ansar Commander took the land lease from the vested property department and filed other class suit No. 98 of 1981 for setting aside the decree passed in other class suit No. 292 of 1979. The other class suit No. 98 of 1981 was dismissed on 31.08.1982 and than filed other class Appeal in the Court of District Judge, Mymensingh which was ultimately dismissed on 18.4.86. The predecessor of the defendant No. 1 filed an application to the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue), Mymenshingh for releasing the property from the vested property and eventually, the said property was released from the list of vested property and subsequently, the property was mutated in the name of the father of the defendant no.1 vide order issued in latter No. 3418(4) S. A. T. and Khatian No. 1034 has been opened in the name of the father of the defendant No. 1 and hence, the suit is barred by law of resjudicata.
